description: This file defines the Collector class responsible for synchronizing data items in the Notesnook project, including methods for checking unsynced changes and collecting items for sync, with encryption and database updates.

classes.name: Collector
classes.description: Handles synchronization of data items, including checking for unsynced changes and collecting items for sync with encryption and database updates.

methods.name: hasUnsyncedChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are any unsynced changes across all sync item types.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Asynchronously collects sync items in chunks, encrypts them, and updates their sync status in the database.
